## **__Magic Beans cost breakdown and current recommended Goal:__**
Bean costs are assuming you have not leveled any of the Night market stuff.
As of writing this, 120 crops (Glassy) is the highest crop.

**EVO GMO**
- Should currently give 0.008x per upgrade. *(originally 0.01x nerfed to 0.005x then buffed to 0.008x)*
- 1.2x Recommended (Level 25, see IT)
- The cost for 1.2x will be 1155 Magic Beans.
A 1.2x Evo GMO multiplier will get you to 120 crops unlocked easily once you create your 1k and/or 200 crop stacks. It is a multi, so something like 1.15x vs 1.2x may seem like a tiny difference, but it's pretty huge.

**SPEED GMO**
- Should currently give 0.3% per upgrade. *(some levels have a weird decimal rounding, but it's 0.3%)*
- 6-7.5% Recommended  (Level 20-25, see IT)
- The cost for 6-7.5% will be 3677 (6%) to 9485 (7.5%)
A 6-7.5% Speed GMO is additive with each 1k stack, but I believe its a multi on your base speed. So getting an extra % won't be a huge gamebreaker, but since you will camp this for a while may as well push what you can. With all buffs unlocked, all 120x Crops at 1k My Seed1 (Apple) are down to a 3 minute cycle and seed5 (Mushrooms) are down to 12 minutes.

**OG FERTILIZER**
- Should currently give 0.01x per upgrade
- 1.2-1.3x Recommended (Level 20-30, see IT)
- The cost for 1.2-1.3x will be 1501 (1.2x), 1967 (1.25x), 3708 (1.3x)
Unsure what the breakpoints are, I have 1.25x which got OG1 to 100% and OG2 to 42%. 
To profit of OG2 you would want it above 50% or OG 3 above 25%. So you could either have less than the 1.25x since OG1 will remain 100% for a while, or try to push it higher to get OG2 above 50%. Either way this bonus is always helpful when you don't check stuff.

**## Bean Farming**
Farming Magic Beans has strong diminishing returns, as a comparison if you would do 100 crops in a single harvest:

100x Mushroom evo 12 = 95 beans  (+95 from 1 cycle)
200x Mushroom evo 12 = 135 beans  (+40 from 2nd cycle)
300x Mushroom evo 12 = 165 beans   (+30 from 3rd cycle)
*(credit to Shydow, thank you)*

You see how it gets terribly worse per cycle. So you want to hoard a ton of tickets, and once you're ready you push your highest seed/evo and do 1-2 cycles of it then hand in the ticket, repeat until night market is setup

- Once you have... lots of tickets, you just do the same mushroom (highest plant/evo) and just hand it in every ~2-3 cycles for lots of beans
- Save up your Instagrowths as these will help you push some plants later on, split plot types.
- Compost could be used for easy 1k stacks, I was getting 1k+ crops per compost pretty early on. Later even 2-3k+. This is why I would split plots. 
- Split Plots: If i know i am getting easily over 1k+ Crops with 1 compost, I can set some plots to a different plant type, and push that, especially Evo1 on something like Earthy/Bulbo since my real plots can skip over that. Alternative is pushing those plots several evo's ahead of your main ones.
- Magic Beans have a big diminishing values on the amount of crops. E.g on 1 Compost i'd get ~120 beans, 2nd Compost would make that ~180beans. That is why having a lot of tickets will be valueable so you can do less cycles to maximize bean gain. If you don't hoard them up you will be stuck with only 2 tickets a day, meaning multiple farming cycles for just 1 ticket, with each cycle netting you less beans.

Upgrade night market, don't know the exact values but I would suggest 1.2x+ Crop Evo, I did 7.5% Growth speed which was very nice, and 1.25x OG chance which gave me 100% chance on OG, 42% on OG2, so either it needs to be higher to break that 50% chance OG2 or it could be lower since OG2 was less relevant. It was nice seeing a lot of 16x-32x plots though.

Since Evo is Multi, that's why I suggest at least 1.2x to be safe or have it easier.

**__Unlocking the 120 Crops__**
Once you have your Night market pushed and all the Tickets spent. Get 1k on all plants. At least Basic and preferably Earthy too, but i just did them all along the way. Also while going through all the plants be sure to stick to some for the upgrades like Land Plots, Stronger Vines/Product Doubler and Nutritious Soil since itll be a lot easier with the 1k stacks now and proper Speed from night market. Just continue to push either 1k's or at least 200's on everything. 
When done, if you still need level 120, just have all plots on highest seed+evo type for best xp.

**__Done with 120 Crops, now what?__** https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1208108939313684621/1224450010977009716
Once done, you have it all, gratz! Now you can either finish off all 1k stacks and i would definetely recommend pushing a lot of day market upgrades first before you ticket. While also letting your tickets stack up again before you ever use one.

# How to get tons of bars?
The Ore Auto-Refill from w3 Construction arm only refills your ore on session (alt change) so your bar production is capped based on your Ore capacity.
This Means if you had 100 Ore capacity and a Bar cost 1 ore to make, If you were offline for a day or 10 years, you would only get 100 bars (+ multipliers from upgrades etc) - This is important for Godshard bars since it costs 15'000 Ore,  you had an ore capacity of 29'999 that would be the same as 15'000+ since you cant make a second bar.


**__How do I actually make the 100 thousands of bars?__**
Simply Archers with the talent Smeltin Erryday (Tab 2, talent 11). 
- This does not get affected by MK if online, but does get affected by MK if offline! 
- You will move archers to do combat in a high kph map (like gmush) and do 2min claims. With proper kph you will cap your bars each time. Alternative is to use Candy (1-2h candy since Each 1h candy is the same as a 2min claim for the bars)
- There are some variables to your "claim time", typically it would be way under 2mins. But for people still progressing it may be worse, since their Talent isnt as high, their kph isnt as good.
- You do NOT need to remove bars from forge.

**__How do i increase my ore capacity + Bar Production?__**
- Forge Upgrades + Gemshop for faster production and multi-bar chance
- W5 Achievement 5M Citringe is +50% Capacity
- Arcade gold coin upgrade (as of writing this currently not on rotation)
W6 NEW!  
- Godshard Card.  Huge buff to Forge CAP + SPEED! (180% for both!)
- Forge Stamp. +x% Forge Max capacity (easily hits 40%+ quickly)
- Oil, +multi bars from oil, W6 oil > W5 oil > Rest. aim for w6 oil, but it's daily! (+60% Extra bar)
- New bribes from a pretty deep Sneaking Jade emporium unlock (Massive 1.3x multiplier, if you're at 100k, that makes it 130k!)

Make sure you get everything, Godshard cards I was getting 400+ cards per 72h candy. (get 100%+ skill effy, max skill speed 62/min, then wear cardchance cards (you can snapshot and candy with it and change to other cards like afk gain etc.

TLDR:
Max Ore Cap+Speed, toss archers to high kph map, do 2min claims on alts.

***Overgrowth Yield***

Haven't seen mention of farming OG rate vs. yield yet, thought I'd add a bit. Lots of maths incoming.

**TL/DR: 2.5x Multi makes OG1 equal to immediate harvest. >3.125x makes 2 ticks of OG attempts effective, >3.829x makes 3 ticks effective.**

The following are what I've seen so far for OG related rates:
Base OG success rate = 1/(2.5^(OGLevel))
Yield = 2^(OGLevel)
Time to OG = Normal Growth Rate

I've also seen a multiplier for OG success rates from beans (4th slot of the Night Market), which introduces a point at which leaving plants to OG will produces a higher yield rate per hour than collecting as soon as plants are harvestable. This is simply a multiplier on our effective yield.
Putting it all together, we can compare base yield to OG yield and find a point at which waiting for OG is generally more effective than harvesting immediately as crops are available. The short of it is as follows:

**At 2.5x OG Multi, OG1 is equally effective as harvesting when available**
Effectively, while it takes twice as long to get to OG1 as it takes for crops to become harvestable, your OG is now guaranteed, giving you the same amount of crops whether you harvest twice at base, or once at OG1.
At this point, you can now harvest half as often and be just as effective.

**At 3.125x OG Multi, OG2 reaches 50% chance, making a second tick of OG time equally as effective as harvesting at OG1**
From this point onwards, *it is more effective to wait for a second tick of OG than it is to harvest quickly.* Once your OG2 chance is above 50% (and until the next breakpoint), you are more likely, on average, to get a better yield from waiting for that second tick than anything else. This is not to be confused with waiting to see OG2!

**At approximately 3.829x OG Multi, 3 OG ticks has a higher yield/hr than 2 OG ticks**
At this multi, OG3's success rate will just tip over 24.5%, and likely show 25% on inspection. On average, only 15% of your crops will hit OG3 after 3 ticks, and around 70% will be OG2.

**At approximately 5.137x OG Multi, 4 ticks takes over as most efficient. Beyond this point, it is worth checking your OG Multi to see if more ticks is worth it or not**
For those that want to play around with numbers, here's a link to the Google Sheets that I've been using myself:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MsSgd6VlDDUdSKmaaZwuDaqe-WsffQ58vzA9GU1R_z0/edit?usp=sharing

Regarding these OG breakpoints, these are the long term averages and expected values being calculated. For high OG multi, it is difficult to say something like 'wait until OG4 to harvest', as a portion of the value is coming from crops that failed early, and have a high chance to still succeed later. My suggestion would be to use this as an indicator of what time to harvest, rather than at what OG.

I've also been asked about EXP gain rates, but I don't yet have enough data to confirm what is best for EXP. Anecdotally, however, it isn't always the highest level seed that gives the best experience. My 2nd seed has gone through a longer evo chain than my 3rd, yet maintains both a higher rate of EXP, and a higher chance of evo. It also has a shorter time to harvest, making it outright better for EXP than my 3rd currently, but insta-growing for EXP would make this point moot.

# How to get tons of bars?
The Ore Auto-Refill from w3 Construction arm only refills your ore on session (alt change) so your bar production is capped based on your Ore capacity.
This Means if you had 100 Ore capacity and a Bar cost 1 ore to make, If you were offline for a day or 10 years, you would only get 100 bars (+ multipliers from upgrades etc) - This is important for Godshard bars since it costs 15'000 Ore,  you had an ore capacity of 29'999 that would be the same as 15'000+ since you cant make a second bar.


**__How do I actually make the 100 thousands of bars?__**
Simply Archers with the talent Smeltin Erryday (Tab 2, talent 11). 
- This does not get affected by MK if online, but does get affected by MK if offline! 
- You will move archers to do combat in a high kph map (like gmush) and do 2min claims. With proper kph you will cap your bars each time. Alternative is to use Candy (1-2h candy since Each 1h candy is the same as a 2min claim for the bars)
- There are some variables to your "claim time", typically it would be way under 2mins. But for people still progressing it may be worse, since their Talent isnt as high, their kph isnt as good.
- You do NOT need to remove bars from forge.

**__How do i increase my ore capacity + Bar Production?__**
- Forge Upgrades + Gemshop for faster production and multi-bar chance
- W5 Achievement 5M Citringe is +50% Capacity
- Arcade gold coin upgrade (as of writing this currently not on rotation)
W6 NEW!  
- Godshard Card.  Huge buff to Forge CAP + SPEED! (180% for both!)
- Forge Stamp. +x% Forge Max capacity (easily hits 40%+ quickly)
- Oil, +multi bars from oil, W6 oil > W5 oil > Rest. aim for w6 oil, but it's daily! (+60% Extra bar)
- New bribes from a pretty deep Sneaking Jade emporium unlock (Massive 1.3x multiplier, if you're at 100k, that makes it 130k!)

Make sure you get everything, Godshard cards I was getting 400+ cards per 72h candy. (get 100%+ skill effy, max skill speed 62/min, then wear cardchance cards (you can snapshot and candy with it and change to other cards like afk gain etc.

TLDR:
Max Ore Cap+Speed, toss archers to high kph map, do 2min claims on alts.

# How to get tons of bars?
The Ore Auto-Refill from w3 Construction arm only refills your ore on session (alt change) so your bar production is capped based on your Ore capacity.

Simply Archers with the talent Smeltin Erryday (Tab 2, talent 11). 
- This does not get affected by MK if online, but does get affected by MK if offline!

**## Bean Farming**
Farming Magic Beans has strong diminishing returns, as a comparison if you would do 100 crops in a single harvest:

100x Mushroom evo 12 = 95 beans  (+95 from 1 cycle)
200x Mushroom evo 12 = 135 beans  (+40 from 2nd cycle)
300x Mushroom evo 12 = 165 beans   (+30 from 3rd cycle)
*(credit to Shydow, thank you)*

You see how it gets terribly worse per cycle. So you want to hoard a ton of tickets, and once you're ready you push your highest seed/evo and do 1-2 cycles of it then hand in the ticket, repeat until night market is setup

- Once you have... lots of tickets, you just do the same mushroom (highest plant/evo) and just hand it in every ~2-3 cycles for lots of beans
- Save up your Instagrowths as these will help you push some plants later on, split plot types.
- Compost could be used for easy 1k stacks, I was getting 1k+ crops per compost pretty early on. Later even 2-3k+. This is why I would split plots. 
- Split Plots: If i know i am getting easily over 1k+ Crops with 1 compost, I can set some plots to a different plant type, and push that, especially Evo1 on something like Earthy/Bulbo since my real plots can skip over that. Alternative is pushing those plots several evo's ahead of your main ones.
- Magic Beans have a big diminishing values on the amount of crops. E.g on 1 Compost i'd get ~120 beans, 2nd Compost would make that ~180beans. That is why having a lot of tickets will be valueable so you can do less cycles to maximize bean gain. If you don't hoard them up you will be stuck with only 2 tickets a day, meaning multiple farming cycles for just 1 ticket, with each cycle netting you less beans.

Upgrade night market, don't know the exact values but I would suggest 1.2x+ Crop Evo, I did 7.5% Growth speed which was very nice, and 1.25x OG chance which gave me 100% chance on OG, 42% on OG2, so either it needs to be higher to break that 50% chance OG2 or it could be lower since OG2 was less relevant. It was nice seeing a lot of 16x-32x plots though.

Since Evo is Multi, that's why I suggest at least 1.2x to be safe or have it easier.

**__Unlocking the 120 Crops__**
Once you have your Night market pushed and all the Tickets spent. Get 1k on all plants. At least Basic and preferably Earthy too, but i just did them all along the way. Also while going through all the plants be sure to stick to some for the upgrades like Land Plots, Stronger Vines/Product Doubler and Nutritious Soil since itll be a lot easier with the 1k stacks now and proper Speed from night market. Just continue to push either 1k's or at least 200's on everything. 
When done, if you still need level 120, just have all plots on highest seed+evo type for best xp.

Hi guys, I wonder why the farming guide tell to buy tickets everyday. Is there any use beyond converting crops into beans?
Is it still adviced to wait for level 80 before mass converting crops into beans?

It's an efficiency thing. There's diminishing returns on conversion. Let's say you can turn in 200 of a crop for 20 beans. If you try to turn in 400 of that same crop, you might get 30 beans. Further, 800 of that same crop might yield only 45 beans.

By buying tickets every day and stockpiling them, you'll be able to do more than 2 conversions a day, netting you more beans in a shorter timeframe.

This is also in the guide itself.

# How to get tons of bars?
The Ore Auto-Refill from w3 Construction arm only refills your ore on session (alt change) so your bar production is capped based on your Ore capacity.
This Means if you had 100 Ore capacity and a Bar cost 1 ore to make, If you were offline for a day or 10 years, you would only get 100 bars (+ multipliers from upgrades etc) - This is important for Godshard bars since it costs 15'000 Ore,  you had an ore capacity of 29'999 that would be the same as 15'000+ since you cant make a second bar.


**__How do I actually make the 100 thousands of bars?__**
Simply Archers with the talent Smeltin Erryday (Tab 2, talent 11). 
- This does not get affected by MK if online, but does get affected by MK if offline! 
- You will move archers to do combat in a high kph map (like gmush) and do 2min claims. With proper kph you will cap your bars each time. Alternative is to use Candy (1-2h candy since Each 1h candy is the same as a 2min claim for the bars)
- There are some variables to your "claim time", typically it would be way under 2mins. But for people still progressing it may be worse, since their Talent isnt as high, their kph isnt as good.
- You do NOT need to remove bars from forge.

**__How do i increase my ore capacity + Bar Production?__**
- Forge Upgrades + Gemshop for faster production and multi-bar chance
- W5 Achievement 5M Citringe is +50% Capacity
- Arcade gold coin upgrade (as of writing this currently not on rotation)
W6 NEW!  
- Godshard Card.  Huge buff to Forge CAP + SPEED! (180% for both!)
- Forge Stamp. +x% Forge Max capacity (easily hits 40%+ quickly)
- Oil, +multi bars from oil, W6 oil > W5 oil > Rest. aim for w6 oil, but it's daily! (+60% Extra bar)
- New bribes from a pretty deep Sneaking Jade emporium unlock (Massive 1.3x multiplier, if you're at 100k, that makes it 130k!)

Make sure you get everything, Godshard cards I was getting 400+ cards per 72h candy. (get 100%+ skill effy, max skill speed 62/min, then wear cardchance cards (you can snapshot and candy with it and change to other cards like afk gain etc.

TLDR:
Max Ore Cap+Speed, toss archers to high kph map, do 2min claims on alts.

## **__Pushing Mastery__**
Mastery is unlocked through W4 Rift, defeating Rift 56, once you Reach F12 you do NOT need to destroy the door on F12, you can change the Mastery at Rift.  Nothing is lost on changing mastery.
- At the time of writing this, the highest legit players are at M2F5. *(By buying many Time skips)*. People who didn't buy any are slowly hitting M2.
- Unlocking M2F3 takes a lot of prep and effort. Pushing for M2F4 isn't as bad though.
- As usual you will constantly push higher floors, more jade <:36pxJade_Coin:1241971902835326986> = more knowledge upgrades, then backtrack a bit. 
- Remember external stealth sources, such as statues and Alch bubble. Jade sources like Killroy, stamp, etc.
## **GEMS:**
Mastery 1 (M1) brings gems which is a huge game changer, their benefits are amazing. 
- The gems are also found on the same floors on higher masteries, like <:36pxGem_Aquamarine:1241966141702930514> is found on M1F2 and M2F2
- Gems can be consumed by holding down on them. Their value is increased additively, so every gem you collect improves your overall value.
- They do have diminishing returns. But getting to around 1k value early on is great. 
- - Gem value of roughly 2.9k is 75% of their max benefit, 4k is 80%, 5.6k is 85%, 9k is 90%.
- <:36pxGem_Aquamarine:1241966141702930514><:36pxGem_Emerald:1241966094911279114><:36pxGem_Garnet:1241966143154028564> are all found on Nunchaku floors, and a lot easier to grind. However <:36pxGem_Starite:1241966144273911839> is on a kunai floor, and a lot harder to obtain.

# **(Inter)Active Sneaking Endgame Min-Max Gear swapping:**
This is not nunchaku vs kunai mode (see w6 pin for that)
This is actual **interactive (clicking) during sneaking, moving gear around**. 
When I say afk, i mean not doing interactive sneaking.
**Notes:**
- Depending on RNG, the difference can be massive. But it is always more efficient to do interactive sneaking in these two cases.
- - Great for **__Unlocking Doors__**, especially if you have 1 good nunchaku and the rest are "meh"
- - Good on high % detect to maximize the chance for all alts at drops/jade. (Only Nunchaku mode)
- I typically stick to alts on page 1, sometimes page 2 alts line up and it's worth doing them.
- Cycle timer decreases in 15 second increments on QuickRef,  1 second increments if you click the W6 tower.

## **Explanation** for Interactive  Sneaking 
- This is hard to explain in text, easier to **watch the attached video.**
- Will use the above icons and setups for easier explanation.
- When I say lowest cycle, I mean the alt with the currently lowest time left until their cycle hits.
**Example:**
If your alts current timers are 2, 5, 7, 8, 8, 15, 15, 15, 22, 22 minutes each. The lowest cycle is 2mins, the  2nd lowest is 5mins, the 3rd lowest is 7mins.

**Steps:**
- Have the above setup.
- Lowest cycle alt (2min) will have <:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268><:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268>   on F1. This will decrease his timer to under 1 min. Once you're in the 15-30sec range you can move him from F1 to F2. Set him up with 🗡️<:36pxCharm_Silk_Veil:1241966090083500082><:36pxCharm_Rosaries:1241966087315390484>. 
- While 🗡️<:36pxCharm_Silk_Veil:1241966090083500082><:36pxCharm_Rosaries:1241966087315390484>.   is hitting the door you find 2nd lowest cycle alt (5min in this example, which is obviously less by now), move him to F1, place <:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268><:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268>  on him.
- Find 3rd lowest cycle alt (7min) just to know who it is as preparation. 
- Keep an eye on <:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268><:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268>  guy, when his timer is ~ 15-30 seconds, you can move him from F1 to F2. Setup  🗡️<:36pxCharm_Silk_Veil:1241966090083500082><:36pxCharm_Rosaries:1241966087315390484>. 
- This is all jus a repeating pattern, you move the <:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268><:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268>  to the 3rd lowest cycle alt and move him to F1 as he is technically your 2nd lowest right now, and lowest is setup with  🗡️<:36pxCharm_Silk_Veil:1241966090083500082><:36pxCharm_Rosaries:1241966087315390484>  on F2.
- You may worry about the two alts at 8 minutes being up soon, but don't, that is the benefit of <:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268><:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268> , it will decrease their time by a lot.

**Other:**
You don't have to switch the full Setup at once, as you can see from my video often I will switch the nunchaku first, then the replace 1 belt, then the other, to maximize on the timer benefit.
The door progress (damage) is higher than the displayed /h  as it accounts for % detect, for actual dmg you can disable the /h display to see actual dmg.

**Why does <:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268><:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268> switching back and forth work?**
In easy words and very simplified as an example.
Imagine <:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268><:36pxCharm_Yellow_Belt:1241966092084318268> decreased your time by half (-50%). And the base time was 200 seconds until the cycle hits, which is now 100s.
If you wait 90s, it is now 10s left, you remove the belts and its 20s left.
However without the belts, if you waited 90s of those 200s it still has 110s left.

referenced_message.content:
## **__Pushing Mastery__**
Mastery is unlocked through W4 Rift, defeating Rift 56, once you Reach F12 you do NOT need to destroy the door on F12, you can change the Mastery at Rift.  Nothing is lost on changing mastery.
- At the time of writing this, the highest legit players are at M2F5. *(By buying many Time skips)*. People who didn't buy any are slowly hitting M2.
- Unlocking M2F3 takes a lot of prep and effort. Pushing for M2F4 isn't as bad though.
- As usual you will constantly push higher floors, more jade <:36pxJade_Coin:1241971902835326986> = more knowledge upgrades, then backtrack a bit. 
- Remember external stealth sources, such as statues and Alch bubble. Jade sources like Killroy, stamp, etc.
## **GEMS:**
Mastery 1 (M1) brings gems which is a huge game changer, their benefits are amazing. 
- The gems are also found on the same floors on higher masteries, like <:36pxGem_Aquamarine:1241966141702930514> is found on M1F2 and M2F2
- Gems can be consumed by holding down on them. Their value is increased additively, so every gem you collect improves your overall value.
- They do have diminishing returns. But getting to around 1k value early on is great. 
- - Gem value of roughly 2.9k is 75% of their max benefit, 4k is 80%, 5.6k is 85%, 9k is 90%.
- <:36pxGem_Aquamarine:1241966141702930514><:36pxGem_Emerald:1241966094911279114><:36pxGem_Garnet:1241966143154028564> are all found on Nunchaku floors, and a lot easier to grind. However <:36pxGem_Starite:1241966144273911839> is on a kunai floor, and a lot harder to obtain.

<:36pxGem_Aquamarine:1241966141702930514> F2 = +% Stealth (caps at 10'000%)
<:36pxGem_Emerald:1241966094911279114> F4 = +% Jade Gain (caps at 5000%)
<:36pxGem_Garnet:1241966143154028564> F6 = +% Door dmg (caps at 2500%)
<:36pxGem_Starite:1241966144273911839> F9 = +% Gold Charm bonus (caps at 200%)
